elements.element: The same liability cap applies to each party on a mutual basis.
elements.evidence: The clause limits “EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY” by reference to the same cap.

elements.element: Fees paid during the relevant measurement period are included in the fee-based cap amount.
elements.evidence: The cap uses “THE TOTAL AMOUNT ACTUALLY PAID BY CORIO HEREUNDER.”

elements.element: Fees payable during the relevant measurement period are included in the fee-based cap amount.
elements.evidence: The clause includes only amounts “ACTUALLY PAID” and does not include accrued or otherwise payable fees.

elements.element: The fee measurement period is the 12 months preceding the claim.
elements.evidence: The clause uses the twelve months immediately preceding filing of the cause of action to which the liability relates.

elements.element: The cap cannot be less than USD 1,000,000, implementing the greater-of formulation.
elements.evidence: No USD 1,000,000 floor or other greater-of mechanism appears.

elements.element: Indirect damages are excluded on a mutual basis.
elements.evidence: The clause states that neither party is liable to the other for “INDIRECT” damages, subject to the stated Section 8 exception.

elements.element: Consequential damages are excluded on a mutual basis.
elements.evidence: The clause states that neither party is liable to the other for “CONSEQUENTIAL” damages, subject to the stated Section 8 exception.

elements.element: Liability for breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: “LIABILITY FOR BREACH OF SECTION 10 (CONFIDENTIALITY)” is expressly excluded from the liability cap.

elements.element: Liability for breach of data protection obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: There is no express carve-out for data protection obligations.

elements.element: Liability for breach of security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: There is no express carve-out for security obligations.

elements.element: Liability arising from indemnification obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Liability arising under Section 8 is expressly excluded from the cap, and Section 8.1 contains Commerce One's indemnification obligation.

elements.element: Liability arising from gross negligence is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Liability arising from a party's “GROSS NEGLIGENCE” is expressly excluded from the cap.

elements.element: Liability arising from wilful misconduct is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Liability arising from a party's “WILLFUL MISCONDUCT” is expressly excluded from the cap; the spelling variation does not change the substance.

elements.element: Liability arising from fraud is uncapped.
elements.evidence: There is no express fraud carve-out.

elements.element: Liability arising from infringement of the other party's intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 8.1 concerns third-party infringement claims against the Software, not direct infringement of the other contracting party's intellectual property.

elements.element: Customer payment obligations are expressly excluded from the definition or treatment of damages for purposes of the cap.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no statement that Corio's payment obligations are not damages or otherwise remain outside the cap.

elements.element: The same liability cap applies to each party on a mutual basis.
elements.evidence: The operative language applies the cap to “EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY.”

elements.element: The cap equals the aggregate fees for the 12 months preceding the claim, without a per-transaction limitation.
elements.evidence: The clause uses the total amount actually paid by Corio during the immediately preceding twelve months and removes the original transaction-specific narrowing.

elements.element: Liability arising from indemnification obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Liability arising under Section 8 is expressly excluded from the cap, and Section 8.1 contains an indemnification obligation.

elements.element: Liability for breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Liability for breach of Section 10 (Confidentiality) is expressly excluded from the cap.

elements.element: Liability arising from gross negligence is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Gross negligence is expressly included in the opening carve-out from the cap.

elements.element: Liability arising from wilful misconduct is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Willful misconduct is expressly included in the opening carve-out from the cap.

result.reason: The redline reaches the complete fallback: it retains a mutual 12-month aggregate-payment cap, removes the per-transaction restriction, and adds uncapped confidentiality, gross-negligence, and willful-misconduct liabilities alongside the existing Section 8 indemnification carve-out. It does not reach the preferred position because it omits payable fees, the USD 1,000,000 floor, and carve-outs for data protection, security, fraud, and infringement of the other party's IP, and it does not protect Customer payment obligations from cap treatment. The target changes are otherwise limited and do not contradict unrelated commercial terms.
